errors.evidence: The description of the MAE line (blue) fails to mention the plateau where the value remains constant at approximately 0.735 between layer 4 and layer 5.
The description of the Corr line (red) fails to mention the plateau where the value remains constant at approximately 0.791 between layer 1 and layer 2.

errors.text_span: 随后在层数5时再次达到0.800
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the Corr line reaches 0.800 again at layer 5. Visually, the value at layer 5 (approx. 0.798) is lower than the peak at layer 3 (approx. 0.799). Using the word 'again' ('再次') falsely implies the two peaks are of equal height.
